research_result:
## Company Overview / 公司概况

**English:**
- SKEQI思客琦 states on its official website that it is a high-tech enterprise engaged in R&D, production and sales of intelligent equipment, and provides overall intelligent manufacturing solutions centered on intelligent equipment; main products include new-energy intelligent equipment, intelligent equipment for other industries, and industrial digital software and services. (**Verified**, [1])
- The official website describes the company as an “industry-leading module/PACK complete-line integrator” / “新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商”. (**Verified**, [1])
- The official website also gives an address in Ningde, Fujian Province, plus phone and email contact information. (**Verified**, [1])
- A third-party job posting says SKEQI has four manufacturing bases in Ningde Jiaocheng, Ningde Dongqiao, Shanghai Songjiang and Dalian Beihai; the employee count is not visible in the quoted text. (**Verified** for four bases; **Not enough evidence** for exact employee count, [3])
- An industry publication reports that 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司 was established in 2016, with registered capital of RMB 100 million, and is mainly engaged in special-purpose equipment manufacturing. (**Verified** as reported by a third-party source, [2])
- The exact founding year of the SKEQI group is **Not enough evidence**: [3] shows a blank year and [1] does not state one. (**Not enough evidence**, [1][3])
- Source priority: no direct conflict was found; the official company website [1] is treated as the highest-priority source for company description.

**中文：**
- 思客琦在官网称自己是专业从事智能装备研发、生产和销售的高新技术企业，为客户提供以智能装备为核心的智能制造整体解决方案；主要产品包括新能源智能装备、其他行业智能装备和工业数字化软件及服务。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网称公司是“行业领先的模组/PACK整线集成商” / “新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商”。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网还列出了福建省宁德市的地址、电话和邮箱联系方式。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 第三方招聘信息显示，思客琦在宁德蕉城、宁德东侨、上海松江、大连北海设有四大产业制造基地；员工人数在引用文本中未显示。（四大基地为 **Verified**；员工人数为 **Not enough evidence**，[3]）
- 行业媒体报道，宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司成立于2016年，注册资本10000万元人民币，主要从事专用设备制造业。（第三方转述为 **Verified**，[2]）
- 思客琦集团的确切成立年份 **证据不足**：来源[3]中年份显示为空，来源[1]未给出。（**Not enough evidence**，[1][3]）
- 来源优先级：未发现直接冲突；公司描述以官网[1]为最高优先级来源。

## Core Business / 核心业务

**English:**
- The company is deeply rooted in the new-energy intelligent equipment field, providing new-energy equipment, production lines and solutions covering cell assembly, module formation, PACK packaging, and battery recycling/disassembly. (**Verified**, [1])
- It also operates intelligent logistics, laser application technology, industrial non-destructive testing, precision intelligent manufacturing, and automobile/parts production-line businesses. (**Verified**, [1])
- It provides industrial digital software and services, including the self-developed 琦航数字工厂系统 (QIHANG Digital Factory System). (**Verified**, [1])

**中文：**
- 公司深度扎根新能源智能装备领域，提供新能源设备、产线及解决方案，产品涵盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解等电池制造流程。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 公司还经营智能物流、激光应用技术、工业无损检测、精密智造、汽车与零部件生产线等业务。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 公司提供工业数字化软件及服务，包括自主研发的琦航数字工厂系统。（**Verified**，[1]）

## Products & Services / 产品与服务

**English:**
- 新能源智能装备 (New Energy Intelligent Equipment): covers cell assembly, module formation, PACK packaging, and battery recycling/disassembly. (**Verified**, [1])
- 琦航数字工厂系统 (QIHANG Digital Factory System): a self-developed industrial management system with pack-line workstations, line-side warehouses, welding lines, WMS warehouse management, MES production execution, Qihang supply-chain management, and big-data visualization dashboards; based on 5G, it supports digital control and visualization of the whole production process. (**Verified**, [1])
- 科派乐智能物流 (Intelligent Logistics): uses intelligent conveying systems as the core, combined with intelligent handling, warehousing and non-standard automation; provides intelligent logistics solutions for new energy, automotive manufacturing, 3C electronics, etc. (**Verified**, [1])
- 激光应用技术 (Laser Application Technology): provides one-stop laser solutions for new energy, automobile/parts, industrial engineering and other fields; core technologies include laser welding, laser energy control, and laser shaping. (**Verified**, [1])
- 工业无损检测 (Industrial Non-Destructive Testing): provides high-end 2D/3D X-ray intelligent inspection equipment and solutions, applied to new-energy batteries, electronic/semiconductor welding defects, automotive parts, aerospace, and more. (**Verified**, [1])
- 精密智造 (Precision Intelligent Manufacturing): provides precision machining, product processing and mold manufacturing, covering R&D/design/development/production of industrial equipment parts, molds, precision plastics, plastic parts, hardware parts, battery parts, and electrical components. (**Verified**, [1])
- 汽车与零部件 (Automobiles and Components): provides flexible, automated, intelligent production lines for automotive parts companies and OEMs, including body parts, chassis parts, and BIW (white body) welding equipment lines. (**Verified**, [1])

**中文：**
- 新能源智能装备：涵盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解等电池制造流程。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 琦航数字工厂系统：思客琦自主研发的工业管理系统，配备PACK线工位、线边库、焊接线及WMS仓储管理、MES生产执行、琦航供应链管理等系统，搭配大数据综合可视化看板，依托5G技术实现生产全流程数字化管控与可视化呈现。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 科派乐智能物流：以智能输送系统为核心，结合智能搬运、仓储及非标自动化系统，为新能源、汽车制造、3C电子等行业提供智能物流整体解决方案。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 激光应用技术：提供面向新能源、汽车及零部件、工业工程制造等领域的一站式激光应用解决方案；聚焦激光焊接技术、激光能量控制技术、激光整形技术。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 工业无损检测：提供高端（2D/3D）X射线智能检测设备及解决方案，应用于新能源电池、电子半导体焊接缺陷、汽车零部件、航空航天等检测场景。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 精密智造：提供精密加工、产品加工和模具制造等业务，包含工业设备零部件、模具、精密塑胶、塑胶配件、五金配件、电池零部件、电器元件的研发、设计、开发、生产。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 汽车与零部件：以汽车零部件及主机厂为主要客户对象，提供柔性化、自动化、智能化生产线，产品涵盖车身件、底盘件及整车白车身相关焊接装备产线。（**Verified**，[1]）

## Industries Served / 服务行业

**English:**
- Official website: intelligent logistics solutions serve new energy, automotive manufacturing, and 3C electronics industries. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website: laser application solutions serve new energy, automotive and parts, and industrial engineering manufacturing. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website: non-destructive testing is applied to new-energy battery inspection, electronic/semiconductor welding defects, automotive parts, aerospace, and other scenarios. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website: automobile/parts business targets automotive parts suppliers and OEMs. (**Verified**, [1])
- A third-party job posting adds that customer groups include photovoltaic or energy-storage head enterprises such as 晶科能源 and 海辰. (**Verified** as stated in the third-party source, [3])

**中文：**
- 官网：智能物流解决方案服务于新能源、汽车制造、3C电子等行业。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网：激光应用解决方案服务于新能源、汽车及零部件、工业工程制造等领域。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网：工业无损检测应用于新能源电池、电子半导体焊接缺陷、汽车零部件、航空航天等检测场景。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网：汽车与零部件业务以汽车零部件及主机厂为主要客户对象。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 第三方招聘信息补充提到，客户群体包含晶科能源、海辰等光伏或储能头部企业。（第三方来源所述为 **Verified**，[3]）

## Customer Segments / 客户类型

**English:**
- First-party statement (official website): customers include 宁德时代 (CATL), 亿纬锂能, 中创新航, 国轩高科, 小鹏, 零跑汽车, and special-vehicle companies such as 林德 and 杭叉. (**Verified**, [1])
- Third-party statement (job posting): customer groups include leading lithium-battery enterprises such as 宁德时代, 中创新航, 亿纬锂能, 瑞浦能源; EV brands such as 奥迪, 宝马, 福特, 吉利, 上汽, 零跑; and PV/storage head enterprises such as 晶科能源, 海辰. (**Verified**, third-party, [3])
- The same third-party source says business has expanded to markets in Europe, Southeast Asia and North America. (**Verified**, third-party, [3])

**中文：**
- 第一方陈述（官网）：客户包括宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、小鹏、零跑汽车，以及林德、杭叉等特种车辆企业。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 第三方陈述（招聘信息）：客户群体包括宁德时代、中创新航、亿纬锂能、瑞浦能源等头部锂电池企业；奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽、零跑等新能源汽车品牌；晶科能源、海辰等光伏或储能头部企业。（第三方来源所述为 **Verified**，[3]）
- 同一第三方来源称，公司业务已拓展至欧洲、东南亚、北美等海外市场。（第三方来源所述为 **Verified**，[3]）

## Customers & Partners / 客户与合作伙伴

**English:**
- First-party (official website): 思客琦 states its products have served 宁德时代, 亿纬锂能, 中创新航, 国轩高科, 小鹏, 零跑汽车, as well as 林德 and 杭叉 for electric-vehicle transformation support. (**Verified**, [1])
- Third-party (job posting): customer groups are described as including 宁德时代, 中创新航, 亿纬锂能, 瑞浦能源, 奥迪, 宝马, 福特, 吉利, 上汽, 零跑, 晶科能源, and 海辰. (**Verified**, third-party, [3])
- The official website has a “合作伙伴” (partners) navigation item, but the evidence provided does not include a separate named partner list beyond these customer-type references. (**Not enough evidence**, [1])

**中文：**
- 第一方（官网）：思客琦称产品已服务于宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、小鹏、零跑汽车，并为林德、杭叉等特种车辆企业提供电动化转型支持。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 第三方（招聘信息）：客户群体被描述为包括宁德时代、中创新航、亿纬锂能、瑞浦能源、奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽、零跑、晶科能源、海辰。（第三方来源所述为 **Verified**，[3]）
- 官网虽然有“合作伙伴”导航栏目，但所提供证据中未给出单独命名的合作伙伴名单。（**Not enough evidence**，[1]）

## Differentiators / 差异化优势

**English:**
- Official website states it is an “industry-leading module/PACK complete-line provider” in new energy, and shows “TOP 细分市场份额” (top segment market share). (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website says its advantages include high technical maturity, strong cost-control capability, and excellent delivery guarantee. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website highlights the self-developed 琦航5G数字工厂系统, using 5G for digital control and visualization of the entire production process. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official homepage also states “26万㎡宁德二期智造基地逐步投产” for rapid response and efficient delivery. (**Verified**, [1])
- A third-party job posting claims “模组及PACK生产线国内市场占有率排名第一”; however the exact year is not visible in the quoted evidence. (**Verified** as stated by the source; **Not enough evidence** for the year, [3])
- Third-party job posting lists honors including 全国五一劳动奖状, 国家专精特新“小巨人”企业, 国家服务型制造示范企业, 国家级高新技术企业, 福建省科技小巨人领军企业, 福建省企业技术中心, 福建省数字经济核心产业“瞪羚”创新企业, 福建省制造业单项冠军, and industry awards from 高工锂电/高工储能. (**Verified**, third-party, [3])

**中文：**
- 官网称公司是新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商，并展示“TOP 细分市场份额”。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网称公司具备技术成熟度高、成本控制能力强、交付保障能力优等显著优势。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网突出自主研发的琦航5G数字工厂系统，依托5G实现生产全流程数字化管控与可视化呈现。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网首页称“26万㎡宁德二期智造基地逐步投产”，用于快速响应、高效交付。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 第三方招聘信息称“模组及PACK生产线国内市场占有率排名第一”；但引用文本中未显示确切年份。（来源所述为 **Verified**；年份为 **Not enough evidence**，[3]）
- 第三方招聘信息列举的荣誉包括：全国五一劳动奖状、国家专精特新“小巨人”企业、国家服务型制造示范企业、国家级高新技术企业、福建省科技小巨人领军企业、福建省企业技术中心、福建省数字经济核心产业“瞪羚”创新企业、福建省制造业单项冠军，以及高工锂电/高工储能等行业奖项。（第三方来源所述为 **Verified**，[3]）

## Brand Values / 品牌价值观

**English:**
- Official website homepage slogan: “诚信 创新 责任 感恩” (Integrity, Innovation, Responsibility, Gratitude). (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website also uses the phrase “协同共进，质赢未来” in connection with an award news item. (**Verified**, [1])
- The evidence does not provide a more detailed corporate culture statement beyond these slogans. (**Not enough evidence**, [1])

**中文：**
- 官网首页口号：“诚信 创新 责任 感恩”。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网在与获奖相关的新闻中使用了“协同共进，质赢未来”的表述。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 除上述口号外，证据未提供更详细的企业文化说明。（**Not enough evidence**，[1]）

## Recent Developments / 近期动态

**English:**
- 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司 obtained a patent titled “一种贴胶电芯预堆叠二次定位滑台” (a secondary positioning slide for pre-stacked taped cells), with grant publication number CN224662069U and application date September 2025. The patent is designed to ensure taped cells do not easily shift after stacking and to improve placement accuracy. (**Verified**, third-party industry publication, [2])
- Official website news: 思客琦 received CATL's “最佳设备质量响应奖” (Best Equipment Quality Response Award). No specific date is shown in the evidence. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website news: on December 9, 思客琦 delivered a speech titled “储能制造能效提升路径” at the Gaogong Storage Annual Conference. (**Verified**, [1])
- Official website news: on November 20, 思客琦 received the Gaogong Lithium 15th Anniversary special award “十五年技术跃迁”. (**Verified**, [1])

**中文：**
- 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司取得“一种贴胶电芯预堆叠二次定位滑台”专利，授权公告号CN224662069U，申请日期为2025年9月；该专利能够保证贴胶电芯堆叠后不易偏移，放置精度高。（第三方行业媒体所述为 **Verified**，[2]）
- 官网新闻：思客琦荣获宁德时代“最佳设备质量响应奖”。证据中未显示具体日期。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网新闻：12月9日，思客琦在高工储能年会发表“储能制造能效提升路径”主题演讲。（**Verified**，[1]）
- 官网新闻：11月20日，思客琦荣膺高工锂电十五周年特别奖项“十五年技术跃迁”。（**Verified**，[1]）

## Research Gaps / 信息缺口

**English:**
- Exact founding year of the SKEQI group is not clearly stated in the evidence; [3] has a blank year. (**Not enough evidence**, [1][3])
- Employee count in [3] appears blank (“员工规模近 人”). (**Not enough evidence**, [3])
- The exact year for the “module/PACK production line domestic market share ranked first” claim is not visible in the quoted evidence. (**Not enough evidence**, [3])
- The relationship between the SKEQI group and the legal entity 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司 is not explicitly explained in the evidence. (**Not enough evidence**, [1][2][3])
- No financial figures, full named partner list, organizational chart, or detailed “partners” list beyond customer names are provided in the evidence. (**Not enough evidence**, [1][2][3])
- The official website contains navigation to pages such as company profile, development history, honors, culture, and news, but the full contents of those pages are not included in the evidence. (**Not enough evidence**, [1])

- 证据未明确解释“思客琦”集团与法人实体“宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司”的关系。（**Not enough evidence**，[1][2][3]）
- 证据中未提供财务数据、完整合作伙伴名单、组织架构，或除客户名称之外的详细“合作伙伴”名单。（**Not enough evidence**，[1][2][3]）
